name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-05-26, at wavelengths from 1.34 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
